sources.title: vit-base-patch16-224-in21k: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: A: The vit-base-patch16-224 adds ImageNet-1k fine-tuning after ImageNet-21k pretraining, optimizing it for standard 1,000-class image classification. Use that version if you need ready-made ImageNet classification; use this model only if you plan custom fine-tuning on your own dataset. Q: What happens if I use images that are not 224x224?

sources.snippet: The Vision Transformer (ViT) is a transformer encoder model (BERT-like) pretrained on a large collection of images in a supervised fashion, namely ImageNet-21k, at a resolution of 224x224 pixels.
